name: Uchuu Harem ~Ishu Kouhai toka Nan toka~
original_name: 宇宙ハーレム～異種交配とかなんとか～
source:
When I woke up, I was in restraints. Around me were a bunch of girls I'd never seen before. It seems they were visitors from the far side of the galaxy. What did they they want? 

"You were chosen." 
"Why... me?" 
"Because you're hot... Po///~" (alien noise) 

I guess my ugly Earth looks are attractive to aliens.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170331.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
醒来时，我发现自己被束缚着，周围是一群从未见过的女孩。她们似乎来自银河的另一端。她们到底想干什么？

“你被选中了。”
“为什么……是我？”
“因为你很帅……啵///～”（外星人的声音）

看来，我这张在地球人眼中丑陋的脸，对外星人倒很有吸引力。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170331.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
